reference.title: Pull Request Merge Strategies
reference.shortdesc: A reference of supported branch merge strategies, commit preservation rules, and recommended use cases for repository maintainers.

section.title: Supported Merge Methods
section.p: Select the appropriate merge method based on branch lifetime and commit history requirements:

row.entry: Preserves all individual branch commits and appends an explicit merge commit.
Feature branches requiring complete historical traceability during audits.
Combines all branch commits into a single unified commit on the target branch.
Documentation edits, minor bug fixes, or long-running PRs with noisy histories.
Reapplies individual commits onto the target branch sequentially without a merge commit.
Linear repository histories where clean individual commit tracking is required.
